skill.summary: Apply SCAMPER creative thinking method to develop ideas, adapt frameworks, generate hackathon concepts, or break through when stuck. Use when Enzo says "SCAMPER this", asks to develop/expand an idea, wants hackathon concepts from existing tools, says he's stuck, or when processing new ideas in the ideas inbox.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of "scamper" skill—apply the SCAMPER creative thinking method for idea development and problem-solving.

- Guides users through 7 SCAMPER lenses: Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to other uses, Eliminate, Reverse.
- Supports Quick, Full, and Targeted SCAMPER brainstorming modes.
- Integrates with idea saving, framework adaptation, and hackathon ideation workflows.
- Provides a structured markdown output template for generated ideas.
